topic: How to structure a developer resume that actually gets past recruiters and lands interviews

post.topic: How to structure a developer resume that actually gets past recruiters and lands interviews
post.linkedin_text:
Recruiters spend six seconds on your resume. Make them count.

Most developer resumes list a wall of tools and framework names. But hiring managers care about what you actually built and the problems you solved.

Here is how to fix your resume today:

• Lead with impact, not just a tech stack
• Quantify results with real metrics
• Keep it strictly to one clean page
• Link directly to live apps and code

Showcase the outcome of your code, not just the syntax you typed.

What is the biggest mistake you see on developer resumes?

slides.title: Fix Your *Developer Resume* In 4 Steps
slides.body: Stop getting ghosted and start landing more interviews.

slides.title: Focus On Impact
slides.body: Do not just list tools. Explain what you built and who used it. Show business value alongside clean code.

slides.title: Use Real Numbers
slides.body: Saying you optimized an API is okay. Saying you reduced API load time by 40 percent gets attention.

slides.title: Link Your Work
slides.body: Always include clickable links to GitHub repositories, live deployments, and case studies. Prove your skills.
